lead.hed: Defense News: Navy awards Boeing first MQ-25A Stingray production contract
lead.insight: Defense News, Tuesday: the Navy awarded Boeing a $562 million fixed-price incentive contract Monday to start Lot 1 low-rate initial production of the MQ-25A Stingray unmanned tanker. The award covers three Lot 1 aircraft plus components for three Lot 2 airframes, with first Lot 1 deliveries slated for 2029. The program of record is 67 operational aircraft and nine test aircraft. Production start, not a carrier-embarked fleet.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo · DVIDS 9935016 · Public domain · First painted MQ-25A Stingray on the ramp at Boeing’s MQ-25 production facility, Mascoutah, Illinois, Aug. 31, 2026.

political.hed: USNI: Houthi fighting continues after Mocha and Perim seizures
political.insight: USNI News, Monday: fighting between the Houthis and Yemen’s internationally recognized government continued over the weekend after the Iranian-backed group captured Mocha and Perim Island late last week, adding a Red Sea foothold on the Bab el-Mandeb. Saudi Arabia faces pipeline challenges in the same report. Seizure claim and continued fighting, not a U.S. battle-damage assessment.

political.hed: USNI: North Korea fires missiles and attack drones at a Sea of Japan island
political.insight: USNI News, Monday: Pyongyang fired short-range ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and attack drones at an island in the Sea of Japan on Sunday as a firepower attack drill, state media said. Subunits from five artillery and missile joint units took part. State-media claim, not a U.S. battle damage assessment.

political.hed: Defense News: France tests smaller tank teams against drones
political.insight: Defense News, Tuesday from Besançon: France’s 7th Armored Brigade is breaking heavy-cavalry platoons into smaller “Lego brick” teams of Leclerc tanks and support vehicles so they present a less valuable target on a drone-watched battlefield, Gen. Maxime Do Tran said. Experiment, not a new French force structure.

tech.hed: Defense News: Air Force secretary says on-orbit space-control weapons are deployed
tech.insight: Defense News, Monday: Secretary Troy Meink told the Air & Space Forces Association conference that the Department of the Air Force has deployed on-orbit space-control weapons to defend the joint force against hostile action. He did not describe the weapon type. Announcement, not a public inventory.

tech.hed: Defense News: Space ISR launches seen rising fourfold this decade
tech.insight: Defense News, Tuesday from Paris: consultancy Novaspace told a space-defense summit that defense-owned ISR satellites launched in 2026–2035 are projected at 2,306, up from 485 in the prior decade. Forecast from a vendor briefing, not a U.S. launch manifest.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: Free-speech maximalism meets material-support law
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: the essay argues Americans increasingly treat any expressive act as beyond reach, including a New York Times framing of terrorism charges after an attack on an ICE facility. Argument, not a court ruling.

culture.hed: Heritage: How schools are remembering — or forgetting — Sept. 11
culture.insight: Heritage Foundation, Monday: this year is the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11 attacks, yet lawmakers in only about half of states require teaching about the event — more than three years ago, the commentary says, but still incomplete. Commentary, not a statute count from every statehouse.
